# SmallBizWire

> A small-business marketing publication. SmallBizWire is published by Drifted Marketing (https://driftedmarketing.com), which also makes Housefly (https://heyhousefly.com). Articles that feature either carry a disclosure.

## Articles

- [How small businesses should actually use AI assistants](https://smallbizwire.blog/how-small-businesses-should-use-ai-assistants/): Skip the novelty. The useful jobs are drafting, remembering and reminding, with a human saying yes before anything goes out.
- [SPF, DKIM and DMARC, explained for people who just want their email delivered](https://smallbizwire.blog/spf-dkim-dmarc-explained/): Three DNS records decide whether Gmail and Outlook trust mail from your domain. Here is what each one does and how to set them up.
- [Cold email warm-up: how to build sender reputation without burning your domain](https://smallbizwire.blog/cold-email-warm-up-guide/): A new mailbox that sends hundreds of emails on day one looks like spam. Warm-up is the slow, boring fix.
- [The cold-email deliverability checklist](https://smallbizwire.blog/cold-email-deliverability-checklist/): Twenty checks to run before your next outbound campaign, from DNS records to the wording of your first line.
- [Shopify SEO for small stores: what actually moves rankings](https://smallbizwire.blog/shopify-seo-guide/): Shopify handles the technical basics. What it cannot do for you is decide what each page is about.
- [How to write a Shopify product page that ranks and sells](https://smallbizwire.blog/shopify-product-page-seo/): A product page has two readers: a search engine deciding what it is about, and a buyer deciding whether to trust you.
- [The anatomy of a landing page that converts](https://smallbizwire.blog/landing-page-anatomy/): One page, one audience, one action. Most underperforming landing pages break at least one of the three.
- [How to choose a marketing agency when you are a small business](https://smallbizwire.blog/how-to-choose-a-marketing-agency/): Ten questions that separate agencies who will move your numbers from those who will send you reports.
- [Marketing agencies for small business: six worth a look](https://smallbizwire.blog/best-marketing-agencies-for-small-business/): A short, honest list across different specialisms and price points, with notes on who each suits.
- [AI assistants for small business: the main options compared](https://smallbizwire.blog/best-ai-assistants-for-small-business/): General chat tools, office-suite assistants and a newer kind you text. What each is good at, and who it suits.
- [Profile: Drifted Marketing, a growth studio for ads, content and AI apps](https://smallbizwire.blog/drifted-marketing-profile/): What the agency says it does, how it says it works, and the questions a prospective client should ask.
- [Profile: Housefly, a private AI assistant you text](https://smallbizwire.blog/housefly-profile/): A memory-first assistant from Drifted Marketing, offered as ten founding seats. What it does and what it will not do.
- [Google Business Profile: the local SEO job most small businesses leave half-done](https://smallbizwire.blog/google-business-profile-local-seo/): For anyone serving a local area, this free listing often matters more than the website.
- [Getting your business mentioned in AI answers: a practical guide](https://smallbizwire.blog/ai-search-visibility-for-small-business/): ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews now answer many questions directly. Here is how to be part of the answer.
- [What is an AI assistant for a small business, and what can it actually do?](https://smallbizwire.blog/what-is-an-ai-assistant-for-small-business/): A plain-English explanation of what these tools are, the jobs they handle well, and the jobs you should keep for yourself.
- [ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini vs Copilot: which suits a small-business owner?](https://smallbizwire.blog/chatgpt-vs-claude-vs-gemini-vs-copilot-for-small-business/): A fair comparison of the four best-known AI assistants, judged on the jobs small businesses actually give them.
- [Is it safe to give an AI assistant access to your inbox?](https://smallbizwire.blog/is-it-safe-to-give-ai-access-to-your-inbox/): It can be, if you check the data terms, grant the narrowest permissions and make the assistant ask before anything is sent.
- [How to write AI prompts for customer replies](https://smallbizwire.blog/how-to-write-ai-prompts-for-customer-replies/): A step-by-step method for getting drafts that sound like your business, state the right facts and need little editing.
- [Why are my emails going to spam?](https://smallbizwire.blog/why-are-my-emails-going-to-spam/): A step-by-step diagnosis, from authentication records to list quality and content, so you can find the actual cause.
- [What is a good email bounce rate and spam complaint rate?](https://smallbizwire.blog/what-is-a-good-email-bounce-rate-and-spam-complaint-rate/): Google's published 0.3% spam rate ceiling, commonly cited bounce benchmarks, and what to do when your numbers slip.
- [How to set up a custom domain email for a small business](https://smallbizwire.blog/how-to-set-up-custom-domain-email-for-small-business/): Step by step with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, from choosing a domain to the DNS records that keep you out of spam.
- [How do I speed up a Shopify store?](https://smallbizwire.blog/how-to-speed-up-a-shopify-store/): Most slow Shopify stores are slow for the same three reasons: too many apps, oversized images and a heavy theme.
- [Shopify vs WooCommerce vs Squarespace: which is best for a small shop?](https://smallbizwire.blog/shopify-vs-woocommerce-vs-squarespace/): A fair comparison of the three platforms small shops most often choose between, and the questions that decide it.
- [How do I write Shopify collection pages that rank?](https://smallbizwire.blog/shopify-collection-page-seo/): Collection pages often target the search terms with the most buyers. Most stores leave them as a bare grid of products.
- [How do I get more Google reviews without breaking the rules?](https://smallbizwire.blog/how-to-get-more-google-reviews/): Asking every customer is allowed. Paying for reviews, offering discounts for them, or only asking happy customers is not.
- [What is NAP consistency and why does it matter for local SEO?](https://smallbizwire.blog/what-is-nap-consistency/): NAP stands for name, address and phone number. When they differ across the web, customers and search engines both get confused.
- [How do I rank in the Google map pack?](https://smallbizwire.blog/how-to-rank-in-the-google-map-pack/): Google says local results are based mainly on relevance, distance and prominence. Here is what you can influence in each.
- [Local SEO checklist for service-area businesses](https://smallbizwire.blog/local-seo-checklist-for-service-area-businesses/): Plumbers, cleaners, electricians and mobile services play by slightly different local SEO rules. Here is the checklist.
- [How much does a marketing agency cost for a small business?](https://smallbizwire.blog/marketing-agency-cost-small-business/): Retainers, project fees and percent-of-spend, explained, with rough ranges and the costs that sit outside the quote.
- [What should be in a marketing agency contract?](https://smallbizwire.blog/marketing-agency-contract-checklist/): Scope, fees, ownership, access, termination and the clauses small businesses most often forget.
- [Freelancer vs agency vs in-house marketer: which should a small business hire?](https://smallbizwire.blog/freelancer-vs-agency-vs-in-house-marketer/): A side-by-side comparison of cost, speed, skills, control and risk, and when each one makes sense.
- [Is it worth hiring an offshore marketing agency from Pakistan?](https://smallbizwire.blog/offshore-marketing-agency-pakistan/): Cost, time zones, payments, contracts and IP: a balanced look at hiring a Pakistani agency from the US.
- [How do US small businesses work with agencies in another country?](https://smallbizwire.blog/how-us-businesses-work-with-overseas-agencies/): A practical setup guide: overlap hours, payments, a written scope and keeping every account in your name.
- [How much does a Shopify store setup cost?](https://smallbizwire.blog/shopify-store-setup-cost/): Plan fees, themes, apps, design and launch work: the components of a Shopify budget, with rough ranges.
- [What are the red flags when hiring a marketing agency?](https://smallbizwire.blog/marketing-agency-red-flags/): Guaranteed results, owning your accounts, vague scope and the other warning signs worth walking away from.
